newsitem.title: USA: Biorelease to buy TheraMed, spin off unit.
newsitem.headline: Biorelease to buy TheraMed, spin off unit.

text.p: Biorelease Corp said on Tuesday it plans to acquire TheraMed Partners Inc to focus on mergers & consolidation of later stage biopharmaceutical technologies and companies.
Biorelease will spin off its blood substitute subsidiary to its stockholders, the company said.

After this agreement, TheraMed and Biorelease's management will hold a a controlling stake in Biorelease, Biorelease said. As part of the agreement, Dr. R. Bruce Reeves will resign as an officer and director of Biorelease, the company said.
Biorelease shareholders will get shares of Biorelease Technologies Inc, which wholds technology and patents in the field of blood substitutes and sustained release drug delivery, the company said.
After the spinoff, Biorelease said it will change its name to Pharmatrage Holdings Inc.

Under the proposed terms, Biorelease will issue approximately 21 million shares of restricted New Biorelease common stock along with certain stock options exercisable for 3.9 million shares of New Biorelease stock to the current stockholders and management of TheraMed.

Immediately following the acquisition, Pharmatrage Holdings will have approximately 30.5 million shares issued and outstanding in addition to approximately 7.5 million shares issuable upon exercise of options, the company said.
